result.name: 1f_view.png
result.panel_note: Left is the untouched original crop. Right is an exact color-distance mask: magenta outlines candidate bands; blue marks only actual support at the peak coordinate. Marks are coordinate references, not entities. Right-panel local coordinates correspond to the same original crop after removing its combined-image offset.
result.evidence_note: Support intervals are measured only at each candidate peak. They do not prove a whole band is continuous or identify a wall. Filtered or empty results do not prove an object is absent.
result.display_note: For a returned-image point (rx, ry), first multiply by original_pixels_per_returned_pixel to obtain full combined-image coordinates (fx, fy). On the left, original image coordinates are (box_left + fx, box_top + fy). On the right, subtract mask_panel_combined_pixels[0] from fx before adding box_left. Prefer candidates and support intervals, which already use original-image coordinates.

source_geometry_self_consistency.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

agent_assumptions: Storey height 4.5m from elevations; ceiling at 4.5, no slab thickness info
Entrance doors/east door/south door have transom lights above 2.6m not modelled as separate openings
Interior door leaf heights assumed 2.4m (no interior elevation supplied)
Wall faces: perimeter outer faces, interior midlines; 540 chain value vs ~240 drawn core unresolved
Top of plan = north (elevation chain correspondence)
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
unresolved: D_R2 (corridor to room_R2) based on a second stacked arc; may be part of a double door for R1
room_R3/R4 suite appears entered only via east double door and D_R34; no corridor door found
Interior door aperture widths approximate (+/-15px) from swing arcs
Exterior wall thickness conflict: chains 540 vs drawn gray core ~240
Transom panes above three doors observed in elevations but merged into door height
Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.

source_validation.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

plan_compilation.basis: 1f_view.png plan: outer wall faces measured x=248..611px (10m), y=151..877px (20m), scale 27.55mm/px, cross-checked against 10000/20000 dimension chains; world x east (west outer face=0), y north (south outer face=0), top of plan = north (confirmed by West/East elevation chain correspondence). Exterior walls drawn ~240 core but chains state 540; representative planes = measured outer faces for perimeter, measured midlines for interior 240 partitions (corridor walls px 404/458, partitions py 298/406/586/370/701/754). Facade openings bound to elevation dimension chains: sill/height from North/South/East/West views (windows z1.0-2.8 or 1.0-3.4, doors z0.2-2.6). Interior door apertures from observed cyan swing arcs (positions approximate +/-15px); leaf heights assumed 2.4m, transoms over entrance/east/south doors not modelled separately.
